name: Apartment Sonnbichl
beschreibung: The Apartment Sonnbichl is a holiday apartment located in **Söll, Tyrol**. The accommodation can accommodate up to six guests. The apartment features a living room, a kitchen and two bedrooms. From the balcony, you’ll enjoy stunning views of the **Wilder Kaiser mountain range**. The apartment is conveniently close to hiking trails and the **Söll ski lifts**. Pets are allowed on a fee basis. The area offers activities year-round.
